urlText: Marayong Station Lift 1 between the concourse and Railway Rd is not available
content:
At Marayong Station Lift 1 between the concourse and Railway Rd is temporarily out of service.
From Monday 16 December to Sunday 29 December, the lift will be closed for maintenance. 
Direct lift access is still available from Harvey Road to the concourse. 
From Railway Road, follow the signs to the underpass, to access the lift on Harvey Road
If you need help, ask staff or phone 02 9851 7241.

urlText: L1 John Street Square lift out of service
content:
The lift on the John Street Square light rail platform towards Dulwich Hill is temporarily out of service until further notice.
 
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
 
Alternative access:
Use the stairs,
·        Or use the lift on the opposite platform
 
For urgent assistance:
Use the Help Point if on the platform
·        Or call 131 500
subtitle: L1 John Street Square lift out of service

properties.smsText: L1 John Street Square lift out of service
properties.speechText: The lift on the John Street Square light rail platform towards Dulwich Hill is temporarily out of service until further notice. For your safety, do not use even if the doors open. For alternative access, use the stairs if able to, or use the lift on the opposite platform. For urgent assistance, use the Help Point if on the platform, or call 131 500.
